official.international_eligibility: Open to researchers from OIC least developed countries (predominantly African) and to researchers employed by institutions in OIC countries
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Natural sciences, applied sciences, engineering and technology; placement must be at a listed COMSTECH Consortium of Excellence (CCoE) member institution

official.description: COMSTECH and prestigious CCoE member institutions jointly offer research fellowships to young researchers in OIC countries so they can spend 6-12 months at a relevant centre of excellence, enhancing the research and development capacity of promising researchers and engineers - especially those from least developed countries - and helping them foster linkages for further collaboration in their fields.

verification.notes: Official COMSTECH fellowship page read in full; it confirms the open rolling call, age limits, duration and the airfare/accommodation/subsistence package, but publishes no monetary figure, no tuition coverage and no fixed deadline.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a rolling, email-only fellowship, so there is no application window to miss - but that also means there is no second deadline to catch, and an incomplete file simply waits for the next review cycle. Your housing and subsistence come from the host lab rather than COMSTECH, so confirm a specific CCoE host can actually take you for the full 6-12 months before you submit.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Early-career engineers and scientists from OIC least developed countries who already hold an M.S. or Ph.D. and have a plausible host laboratory in mind within the COMSTECH Consortium of Excellence.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your country appears on the published OIC least-developed-countries list and shortlist CCoE member institutions working in your field
Contact the prospective host first - placement is at their institution, so their agreement drives the application
Request the supporting statement from your head of institution early; it is a required attachment, not optional
Line up two senior referees who are not your head of institution
Trim your CV to five pages including publications before scanning
common_rejection_risks: Missing any one of the required attachments - the joint committee screens the complete file
Proposing a host that is not a listed CCoE member institution
Exceeding the published age limits of 35 (graduate studies) or 45 (post-graduate studies)
Applying to more than one COMSTECH programme in the same calendar year, which the Fund does not permit
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The page promises only international airfare, accommodation and subsistence; visa fees, local transport, insurance and personal spending are not mentioned and should be assumed to be yours.
document_audit: The passport scan must be of a valid passport - expired copies are not accepted under this scheme
The CV has a hard five-page ceiling including publications
Reference letters must come from senior scientists other than your head of institution
alerts: Only one COMSTECH programme application per calendar year is allowed, so this competes with COMSTECH's other fellowship schemes
The call is open now with no closing date, so files are reviewed as they arrive rather than in one round
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Assemble the form and all attachments, email them to the COMSTECH secretariat in Islamabad, and await joint review with your proposed host institution.
